title: Type→save→persist chain unpinned: no client test asserts Save consumes the TYPED values
detail: Issue acceptance #1 requires Save to persist the NEW contact. Existing save tests assert only inflight/saving flags; the new pin stops at typing. A save reading the wrong key again would silently send stale values.
recommended_fix: Extend the simulate test: click refcheck-edit-save-landlord_ref after typing, assert the rc-1 entry is saving=True and retains the typed email — proving save consumed typed state.

title: Substitute-trio runtime path unexercised: pin drives only RefcheckEditCorrect
detail: Acceptance #2 requires the substitute form to submit a new referee. The pin test drives only RefcheckEditCorrect; the substitute arm (empty prefill, kind-filtered read) is never exercised through the runtime path.
recommended_fix: Add a simulate variant with kind RefcheckEditSubstitute (empty prefill), type into the trio, assert the dict write and the rendered value.

title: Name/phone branches of UserEditedRefcheckTrio untested; `_ -> edit` fallback swallows silently
detail: The diff changed the name and phone dispatch-key lines (reference_panel.gleam:1110, 1124), but no test types into those fields. A wrong field string would hit the `_ -> edit` fallback and silently drop keystrokes — the #611 swallow class.
recommended_fix: Type into the refcheck-edit-name-landlord_ref and refcheck-edit-phone-landlord_ref testids in the simulate test and assert both dict writes.

title: No refetch/reorder step in the pin: key-stability across list changes unproven
evidence:
"    simulate.input(
      sim,
      on: query.element(matching: query.attribute(
        \"data-testid\",
        \"refcheck-edit-email-landlord_ref\",
      )),
      value: \"maeve.fixed@example.ie\",
    )"
detail: Guard demands the pin survive reorder/refetch before save. The test uses one static row, no refetch. The fixture's slot≠id (landlord_ref vs rc-1) implies the bite; the refetch scenario itself is unpinned.
recommended_fix: After typing, dispatch the refetch message with a reordered call list, assert the typed edit survives under rc-1, then save.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0=100%: keyed-typing pin passes (local run: 572 passed, no failures), save-validation pre-covered. P1≈25%: save-payload chain partial, substitute arm partial, name/phone and refetch unpinned. Overall <80%.
recommended_fix: Extend the pin: type name/phone, click Save and assert typed state consumed, drive the substitute arm, add a refetch step. Then gate PASS.
